description: This is a Java source file defining the EntityTestSuite class, which contains extensive unit tests for the Apache OFBiz entity framework. The tests cover various functionalities including model manipulation, CRUD operations, cache behavior, XML serialization, transaction management, and entity relations within the OFBiz system.

classes.name: EntityTestSuite
classes.description: A JUnit test suite for comprehensive testing of the OFBiz entity engine, covering CRUD operations, caching, transactions, serialization, and entity relations.

methods.name: testModels
methods.description: Tests model creation, addition, and removal of entity fields.

methods.name: testMakeValue
methods.description: Tests creating and storing values using delegator methods.

methods.name: testUpdateValue
methods.description: Tests updating entities and observer notification mechanism.

methods.name: testRemoveValue
methods.description: Tests removal of entity values and behavior of immutable entities.

methods.name: testCreateAllValues
methods.description: Inserts multiple values in batch and verifies their creation.

methods.name: testEntityCache
methods.description: Verifies caching mechanisms, cache updates after modifications, and cache invalidation upon entity updates and deletions.

methods.name: testXmlSerialization
methods.description: Tests serializing entities to XML and deserializing back, ensuring data integrity.

methods.name: flushAndRecreateTree
methods.description: Creates a hierarchical test structure of node entities for other tests.

methods.name: testCreateTree
methods.description: Verifies creation and counting of hierarchical node data.

methods.name: testAddMembersToTree
methods.description: Creates entities and associates them within the hierarchy as members.

methods.name: purgeTestingByTypeId
methods.description: Utility to remove test data matching a type ID pattern.

methods.name: createNodeMembers
methods.description: Creates nodes and related test entities within the hierarchy.

methods.name: testCountViews
methods.description: Performs count queries on view-entity relations and verifies cache behavior.

methods.name: testFindDistinct
methods.description: Tests distinct queries and retrieving unique entity combinations.

methods.name: testNotLike
methods.description: Queries entities with NOT LIKE condition to verify filtering.

methods.name: testForeignKeyCreate
methods.description: Ensures foreign key constraints prevent invalid inserts.

methods.name: testForeignKeyRemove
methods.description: Verifies foreign key constraints prevent invalid deletes.

methods.name: testRemoveNodeMemberAndTesting
methods.description: Removes related entities and verifies cascading deletions.

methods.name: testStoreByCondition
methods.description: Tests bulk updates to entities based on conditions.

methods.name: testRemoveByCondition
methods.description: Removes entities matching specific conditions.

methods.name: testRemoveByPK
methods.description: Removes entities by primary key derived from existing entities.

methods.name: testRemoveType
methods.description: Removes entities of a specific test type.

methods.name: testCreateManyAndStoreAtOnce
methods.description: Creates a large number of entities using batch store.

methods.name: testCreateManyAndStoreOneAtATime
methods.description: Creates a large number of entities individually.

methods.name: testEntityListIterator
methods.description: Iterates through large entity lists with an EntityListIterator to verify iteration correctness.

methods.name: testTransactionUtilRollback
methods.description: Verifies transaction rollback functionality.

methods.name: testTransactionUtilMoreThanTimeout
methods.description: Checks that transactions exceeding timeout are rolled back.

methods.name: testTransactionUtilLessThanTimeout
methods.description: Verifies that transactions under timeout are committed successfully.

methods.name: testFieldTypes
methods.description: Tests various field types such as Blob, Clob, Date, Timestamp, BigDecimal, etc., for correct storage and retrieval.

methods.name: testEntitySaxReaderCreation
methods.description: Tests loading entity data from XML with create tags.

methods.name: testEntitySaxReaderCreateSkip
methods.description: Tests skipping creation on duplicate entities loaded via XML.

methods.name: testEntitySaxReaderUpdate
methods.description: Tests loading and updating entities via XML with create-update tags.

methods.name: testEntitySaxReaderReplace
methods.description: Tests replacing existing entities via XML.
